title: Day 1: mix
vo: Day one, at about 9 in the morning. In a clean jar, stir 50 grams of wholemeal rye flour with 50 grams of water at about 26 degrees Celsius, until no dry flour is left. Cover it loosely, and leave it somewhere around 24 degrees for a day.
voUS: Day one, at about 9 in the morning. In a clean jar, stir half a cup of wholemeal rye flour with three and a half tablespoons of water at about 79 degrees Fahrenheit, until no dry flour is left. Cover it loosely, and leave it somewhere around 75 degrees for a day.
cap: Day 1, 9 am: stir 50 g wholemeal rye flour with 50 g water at about 26 °C.
Cover loosely and leave it for 24 hours at about 24 °C.
capUS: Day 1, 9 am: stir ½ cup wholemeal rye flour with 3½ tbsp water at about 79 °F.
Cover loosely and leave it for 24 hours at about 75 °F.
